Bash(git commit -m "$(cat <<''EOF''
Feature: Enhanced Student Dashboard with Parse User Integration

Implemented comprehensive UX improvements to the student dashboard with
real-time Parse User data integration and professional profile display.

Key Changes:
- Parse User Integration: Fetches profile data (firstName, profileImage)
  from Parse backend with localStorage fallback for resilience
- Profile Picture Enhancement: Large circular avatar (16-24px responsive)
  with smart fallback to UI-avatars API when image unavailable
- Profile Completion Tracking: Real-time percentage calculation based on
  7 user fields with visual SVG progress indicator on profile picture
- Match Score Display: Assessment cards now show career match percentages
  (e.g., 95%) for completed assessments with green success styling
- Card Optimization: Reduced StudentAssessmentCard interface from 28 to
  13 fields, removing unused metadata (studentConcerns, nextSteps, etc.)
- Dashboard Cleanup: Removed redundant "Get Support" card to focus
  dashboard on metrics-only content (3 cards: Readiness, University,
  Assessments)

Technical Improvements:
- TypeScript strict mode compliance with proper null/undefined handling
- Graceful error handling with Parse SDK failures
- Mobile-responsive design (sm:, md: breakpoints)
- Zero build errors, zero lint errors
- Dynamic data integration for match scores from user activities

Files Modified:
- frontend/src/components/dashboard/StudentDashboard.tsx
- frontend/src/components/cards/StudentAssessmentCards.tsx
- frontend/src/components/cards/StudentDashboardCards.tsx

Developed by: Antony Were
EOF
